name: Medial Elbow Tendinopathy (Golfer's Elbow)
summary: Medial elbow tendinopathy is a load-related problem of the common flexor-pronator tendon at the medial epicondyle (inner elbow). It is less common than lateral elbow tendinopathy.

looksLike: Inner elbow pain with gripping, wrist flexion and forearm pronation (turning the palm down).
Tenderness just in front of and below the medial epicondyle.
redFlags: Trauma with deformity or inability to move
firstSteps: Medial pain on resisted flexion and pronation, local tenderness, normal range, no laxity: working diagnosis medial elbow tendinopathy.
Ulnar symptoms? Treat nerve sensitivity alongside.

measures: Pain-free grip, pain on resisted flexion and pronation, PRTEE adapted, sport tolerance.

blocks.text: Medial elbow tendinopathy is a load-related problem of the common flexor-pronator tendon at the medial epicondyle (inner elbow). It is less common than lateral elbow tendinopathy. It is seen in golfers, throwers, racket players and workers who grip and twist repeatedly. The ulnar nerve runs just behind the medial epicondyle, so nerve irritation often coexists [Ref – to verify].

items: Inner elbow pain with gripping, wrist flexion and forearm pronation (turning the palm down).
Tenderness just in front of and below the medial epicondyle.

rows: Any tingling in the ring and little fingers?

blocks.text: Palpation of medial epicondyle and flexor-pronator mass; resisted wrist flexion and pronation; grip strength; ulnar nerve tests (Tinel at cubital tunnel, elbow flexion test); valgus stress test; cervical screen.

rows: Elbow extended, forearm supinated; patient flexes and pronates against resistance
Passive wrist extension with elbow extended and forearm supinated
Elbow flexed 20 to 30 degrees; stabilise the humerus; apply outward force at the forearm
Shoulder abducted, elbow fully flexed; apply valgus and quickly extend the elbow
UCL injury in throwers [Ref – to verify]

sections.title: G. RED FLAGS AND URGENT CONDITIONS

rows: Trauma with deformity or inability to move

steps: **Medial pain on resisted flexion and pronation, local tenderness, normal range, no laxity:** working diagnosis medial elbow tendinopathy.

items: Education and load management as for lateral elbow tendinopathy (Vol 6 Ch 1).
Exercise: isometric wrist flexion and pronation, then slow heavy wrist flexor, pronator and grip strengthening, then sport-specific loading (golf swing, throwing progressions).
Manual therapy: optional soft-tissue work and elbow mobilisation for short-term comfort; ulnar nerve sliders if nerve signs.
Avoid repeated corticosteroid injections near the ulnar nerve and tendon [Ref – to verify].

blocks.text: Pain-free grip, pain on resisted flexion and pronation, PRTEE adapted, sport tolerance.

items: **Why check the ulnar nerve?** It lies close to the medial epicondyle and is often irritated alongside.
**Which test helps detect UCL injury in throwers?** Moving valgus stress test.
**What is the core treatment?** Progressive tendon loading.
**Child pitcher with medial elbow pain?** Consider apophysitis; reduce throwing and refer.
**How is it different from lateral elbow tendinopathy?** Pain on resisted wrist flexion and pronation rather than extension.

sections.title: Now You Should Be Able To

items: Diagnose medial elbow tendinopathy and screen for UCL and ulnar nerve problems.

sections.A: Golfer's elbow kohni ke andar ki taraf tendon ka load se juda masla hai, jahan kalai mor ne aur haath ulta karne wali muscles judti hain.
sections.B: Kohni ke andar dard jo pakarne, kalai morne aur hatheli neeche karne par barhta hai, aur medial epicondyle ke aage dard.
sections.C: Chhoti aur ring finger mein jhunjhunahat (ulnar nerve) aur phenkne wale khel mein 'pop' (ligament) ke baare mein zaroor poochein.
sections.D: Medial epicondyle aur muscles dabayein, resisted wrist flexion aur pronation, grip aur ulnar nerve check karein.
sections.E: Resisted wrist flexion aur pronation wahi dard laate hain. Ligament aur nerve ke tests bhi saath karein.
sections.F: Ulnar collateral ligament ki chot aur cubital tunnel isi jaise lag sakte hain.
sections.G: Chot ke baad kharabi ya movement na hona, ya haath ki barhti kamzori: foran refer.
sections.H: Red flags na hon, andar dard resisted test par, range normal aur ligament dheela na ho: golfer's elbow.
sections.I: Ilaaj tennis elbow jaisa hai: education, load control, aur pehle isometric phir dheere dheere bhaari exercise.
sections.M: Dard ke baghair grip, resisted test par dard, PRTEE aur khel ki bardasht dobara dekhein.
sections.N: Sawaal hal karein. Ulnar nerve isi jagah ke paas hai, is liye hamesha check karein.
sections.now-you-should-be-able-to: Yeh checklist hai. Har point khud kar sakein to tick karein.
